title: Research-quality benchmark contract and baseline evaluator v0
problem: The current tests verify quote presence and pipeline contracts but do not measure whether accepted outputs are legitimate research claims. Live evidence contains bibliography titles, access-challenge text, and redirect text that passed admission. Phase 4 needs a deterministic benchmark and honest baseline before validators are changed.
acceptance_criteria: A versioned, domain-neutral manifest defines at least 40 annotated candidate decisions across at least 10 document fixtures, with raw counts reported for every metric.

The corpus contains valid scoped findings and explicit negative slices for bibliography/reference text, navigation, access challenge or bot page, redirect shell, methods presented as findings, cited background, unsupported generalization, and quote/claim mismatch.
Committed fixture text is synthetic or redistribution-compatible; every non-synthetic source records license, canonical URL or identifier, checksum, and excerpt boundaries.
The deterministic evaluator reports precision, recall, F1, false-acceptance rate, per-slice counts, and reason-code confusion without a live model or network.
A baseline artifact can honestly report failing metrics; tests validate calculations and known failure reproduction rather than requiring an artificially passing baseline.
No benchmark candidate writes to production accepted graph tables or public exports.
On completion, ticket-414 changes from blocked to ready; no later Phase 4 ticket is activated.
test_plan: With RGE_LLM_MODE=mock and RGE_ALLOW_LIVE_LLM=0: python -m pytest tests/unit/test_research_quality_benchmark.py -q
With RGE_LLM_MODE=mock and RGE_ALLOW_LIVE_LLM=0: python -m pytest tests/golden -q
non_goals: Do not change claim acceptance behavior in this ticket.
Do not run live Ollama, paid APIs, or source network requests.
Do not claim the small benchmark represents arbitrary-domain performance.
Do not add retrieval or answer generation.
rollback_plan: Remove the benchmark module, fixtures, tests, and baseline artifact support; restore ticket-414 to blocked. No production data migration is involved.
